body.description:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(autoflow):** add autoflow workflow cancel ([86ff6c5d](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/86ff6c5d)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **feat(autoflow):** add autoflow workflow get ([33ab6e14](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/33ab6e14)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **feat(autoflow):** add autoflow workflow send ([8d27dd6b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8d27dd6b)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **feat(autoflow):** add autoflow workflow start ([beba5177](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/beba5177)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **feat(autoflow):** connect to a local AutoFlow service without TLS ([9d82a5af](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9d82a5af)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->   
* **feat(autoflow):** default the namespace to the token's organization ([50a9780e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/50a9780e)) by Timo Furrer<!--team-->

body.description:
## Changelog   
### ✨ Features   
* **feat(api):** accept PKCS#12 and DER client certificates ([a54dd94b](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a54dd94b)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->

* **feat(govern):** redact values assigned to credential-like names in text ([204bd639](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/204bd639)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(govern):** use Duo Agent Platform key names in audit events ([7065aefd](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/7065aefd)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(milestone):** add --include-descendants to milestone list ([8a2d643a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8a2d643a)) by Abdelrahman Megahed<!--community-->   
* **feat(minder):** rename glab govern to glab minder ([31a5b6e1](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/31a5b6e1)) by Jean van der Walt<!--team-->   
* **feat(release):** add --clobber and --skip-existing to download ([e343a4a5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e343a4a5)) by Yarra Vivek<!--community-->   
* **feat(service-account):** Add the create, update and delete commands ([9bee6cb5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9bee6cb5)) by Pawel Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(service-account):** Add the list and get commands ([2200452e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2200452e)) by Pawel Farys<!--community-->   
* **feat(stack):** make reorder and infer usable without a TTY ([a6a0d574](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a6a0d574)) by Abdelrahman Megahed<!--community-->   
* **feat:** add timelog command for time tracking ([c66fd5fa](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/c66fd5fa)) by Giannis Kepas<!--community-->   
### 🐛 Bug Fixes   
* **fix(artifact-registry):** correct the token exchange prerequisite ([a351dcb8](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a351dcb8)) by José M. Requena Plens<!--community-->   
* **fix(auth):** stop resending a dead OAuth refresh token ([93073794](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/93073794)) by Lucas Charles<!--community-->   
* **fix(auth):** validate OAuth client ID before browser step ([b3fbc759](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/b3fbc759)) by Abdelrahman Megahed<!--community-->   
* **fix(cmdutils):** say how to set ssh_host when a remote is on a subdomain of a logged-in host ([704bba79](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/704bba79)) by Johan Walles<!--community-->   
* **fix(config):** honour GLAB_PROXY for the proxy key ([8ff30e46](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8ff30e46)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* **fix(config):** share local config across git worktrees ([9f834e27](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/9f834e27)) by Jeston Singh<!--community-->   
* **fix(df):** check Maven packages fetched through a mirror ([f796daed](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f796daed)) by Hannah Baker<!--team-->   
* **fix(df):** check and forward plain-HTTP requests through the proxy ([49b84ef3](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/49b84ef3)) by Hannah Baker<!--team-->   
* **fix(help):** show argument and environment variable sections again ([86659706](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/86659706)) by Arpit Gogia<!--community-->   
* fix(issuable view): fetch all note pages when showing comments ([f49808d9](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/f49808d9)) by Dextheking1<!--community-->   
* **fix(note):** keep a piped body when --attach is set ([6bfeca37](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/6bfeca37)) by Andrei Zubov<!--team-->   
### 📝 Documentation   
* **docs(auth):** say client_id is ignored on GitLab.com ([4b8f993a](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/4b8f993a)) by Hamza Hassanain<!--community-->   
* **docs(mr):** describe milestone filter as a title ([445203da](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/445203da)) by wushuwen<!--community-->   
* **docs(skills):** expand glab-stack guidance for non-interactive reorder and infer ([a09b525e](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/a09b525e)) by Jay McCure<!--team-->   
* **docs:** update TW assignments handbook link in docs metadata ([e840eebd](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/e840eebd)) by Marcel Amirault<!--team-->   
### 🔧 Maintenance

* **chore(lint):** run rumdl on root Markdown files ([42fe3283](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/42fe3283)) by Lysanne Pinto<!--team-->   
* **chore(localization):** add CODEOWNERS entry for docs-locale ([8e536821](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/8e536821)) by Iryna Rogova<!--team-->   
* **chore:** update dependency firewall code owners ([2fca7db5](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/commit/2fca7db5)) by Hannah Baker<!--team-->
